meta.title: Line-Item Assignment Rule Engine: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Sign in as the Procurement Manager on a tenant below Growth and a tenant on Growth while keeping the same user role.
Determine or compare the tenants' subscription plans, including confirming that one is below Growth and the other is Growth.
Open and use the Line-Item Assignment Rule Engine.
Verify that the capability is absent or refused on the lower-plan tenant.
Verify that category, location, and value rules auto-assign PR line items on the Growth tenant.
